SASBDB entry SASDMS6  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDMS6/)

Publication: Knott et al. (2022), Nucleic Acids Res 50, 522 (paper not read)
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkab1216

The files are the SASBDB downloads, unchanged (nothing was cleaned):
  experimental_data/SASDMS6.dat   the curve (columns q, I, error)
  SASDMS6_fit1.fit              the CRYSOL fit of "fit1"
  SASDMS6_fit1_model1.pdb: NONO homodimer, PDB 5IFM chains K and L
Only fit1 is used. Script: test/fitting_tests/SASDMS6/ (buffer, temperature and wavelength: see its header comments).
Added 2026-11-15; not yet run.
